title: fix(fma): match Krita on Windows by its real programs.name

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+- Fixed the Krita (Windows) Fleet-maintained app's `exists` and `patched` queries so they match the installed app and the patch policy fails on hosts running an older version.

@@ -3,8 +3,8 @@
     {
       "version": "5.3.4.1",
       "queries": {
-        "exists": "SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Krita_x64' AND publisher = 'Krita Foundation';",
-        "patched": "SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Krita_x64' AND publisher = 'Krita Foundation' AND version_compare(version, '5.3.4.1') < 0);",
+        "exists": "SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Krita%' AND publisher = 'Krita Foundation';",
+        "patched": "SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Krita%' AND publisher = 'Krita Foundation' AND version_compare(version, '5.3.4.1') < 0);",
         "open": "SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'krita.exe');"
       },
       "installer_url": "https://download.kde.org/stable/krita/5.3.4.1/krita-x64-5.3.4.1-setup.exe",
